text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of Sounds of Earth's debut race has finally arrived—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! My body feels ready to burst with joy!
I want to jam with everyone right away...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With the real race ahead of him, Sounds of Earth was overflowing with spirit. Or rather—
choice_data_list: (Is it overflowing a bit too much...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having fighting spirit is good, but leaning too far forward
into it renders it meaningless.
She'll need to cool down a bit.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
ââFirst, relax.
And then, observe how the others move, right?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Tap, tap, tap, tap, tap...—
Don't rush; feel the rhythm of your surroundings—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Step by step... building up my running!
Gradually getting stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Her pace turns slightly firmer, accelerating rapidly!
It's time to let loose! Reaching maximum volume in the blink of an eye!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The session enters its finale!
Passionately! Unleash everything!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Sounds of Earth is hyped for the race,
but beneath it all, she still retains
the cool-headed composure needed to battle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From that earlier 'rehearsal',
I could see her cleverness in faithfully executing our strategy...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Then by all means, please enjoy yourself alongside me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sounds of Earth's debut race is about to start————!!
